headline: Task force approves new definitions for Scoring Principles including Collaboration, Sustainability, and Guiding Principles categories
summary: The Priority Setting Task Force voted on clarifying definitions for the Scoring Principles, including Guiding Principles and Collaboration sections. The group approved definitions for Measurable Community Impact, Diversity & Inclusiveness, Priority to Lower Incomes, Location, Sustainability (Social Services), Sustainability (Development), and Collaboration. The exact name for the Collaboration scoring category was tabled for the next meeting.
decisions: Accepted the meeting notes from the previous meeting.
Agreed on definitions for Measurable Community Impact, Diversity & Inclusiveness, Priority to Lower Incomes, and Location.
Agreed on separate Sustainability definitions for Social Services and Development applications.
Agreed on a definition for the Collaboration scoring category.
Tabled the exact name for the Collaboration scoring category until the next meeting.

decision_evidence.quote: The meeting notes from the previous meeting were unanimously accepted.
The PSTF defined and agreed upon the following definitions: Measurable Community Impact... Diversity & Inclusiveness... Priority to Lower Incomes... Location
The PSTF agreed upon the following definitions: Sustainability (Social Services)... Sustainability (Development)

The PSTF agreed upon the following definition: Applicant demonstrates awareness of current service provider ecosystem and identifies opportunities for collaboration with organizations that provide services similar to the proposed project.
The exact name for this scoring category (e.g., Service Value, Environmental Scan, Community Needs Assessment) was tabled for the next meeting.
